model_name: Orbital Economy v7.7.13 r1 — Labor Market
notes: v7.7.13: Planet v2 step 3 — the labor market closes the loop: demand per capita (A level) x population, a wage that follows labor tightness (10 %/year, floor 30 %, target 0.95), output limited by labor availability as a guard; one labor_market node, model/nodes/labor_market.json, switch Labor Market Enabled; P6 demand drivers are the per-capita norms. Household-income demand is deferred to the finance layer. See docs/tasks/034-labor-market/.
Modes 0-51 keep Labor Market Enabled = 0 and reproduce v7.7.12 r1 exactly; Mode 52 = Mode 49 with the labor market, Mode 53 = Mode 50 (transport surge with food) with the labor market.
Exact numbers are defined on the canonical platform (docs/VERSIONING_AND_AUTHORITY.md section 8); series-digest.windows.json is the golden.
